# Draft:Love and War (upcoming film)

Love and War is an upcoming Indian Hindi-language epic saga film written and directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali. It is also produced by Bhansali under Bhansali Productions. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt and Vicky Kaushal in the ensemble lead cast. Release is announced for a release sometime in 2026.
